title: cosmos calibration
description: What this rig measured in this room on this day: per head, the DMX that aims it at the ball.

mount_mode.description: must match rig.json's mount_mode -- a reading taken in one mode calibrates a physically different transform and is not convertible

fixture.description: must match a fixture 'name' in rig.json exactly

ball_dmx.description: the two 0-255 readings with the head aimed at the ball, as [pan, tilt]

version.description: Format version. Current is 1; a file with no version is treated as 1.
